sources.title: REX-SC: Range-Extended Stochastic Computing Accumulation for Neural Network Acceleration
sources.verified_claim: Explicitly compares no-truncation and saturating configurations; saturating adders limited to6 bits. Signed saturation depends on computation order; unmodeled intermediate saturation can hurt model accuracy.

sources.title: SC-DCNN: Highly-Scalable Deep Convolutional Neural Network using Stochastic Computing
sources.verified_claim: Approximate per-cycle parallel counting uses fewer logic gates and lower precision. 16-input example uses4 output bits with LSB weight2; it is not an arbitrary-width temporal accumulator.

sources.title: DS-CIM: Digital Stochastic Computing-In-Memory Featuring Accurate OR-Accumulation via Sample Region Remapping for Edge AI Models
sources.verified_claim: Eight D-latches cache four 2-bit outputs, then update the accumulator once every4 cycles. Reported accumulation energy reduction56%, macro power reduction21.8%, area increase10%; these are paper-specific, not our PPA.
